detection.note: Yellow paper plant detection: H(20-32)=pure yellow only, S(80+)=vivid colors only, V(60+)=bright regions. Excludes green plants and shadows.

periodic_capture.note: Captures full-resolution images at regular intervals during mission. Saved locally only (no WiFi).

pixhawk.note: TELEM2 at 921600 baud (high-speed). read_only=true prevents flight commands, allows telemetry reading and STATUSTEXT detection sending only.

mavlink_command_receiver.note: DISABLED - Conflicts with dronekit's message receiver. Use Socket.IO for Pi control instead.

mavlink_detection.description: PRIMARY detection transmission - Telemetry radio only, no WiFi
mavlink_detection.note: All detection transmission via long-range MAVLink radio. Pi has no WiFi dependency. Messages sent via Pixhawk TELEM2, forwarded to TELEM1, transmitted to GCS.

safety.note: DISABLED - Safety monitoring and emergency actions handled by GCS and Pixhawk only. Pi is detection-only, no flight commands.

socketio.note: DISABLED - Telemetry radio only mode. Pi operates without WiFi. All data transmitted via MAVLink telemetry.
